overall: Board violated the OML by making insufficiently detailed February 26, 2014 minutes; it complied with the OML 2014-10 order on April 8, 2013 minutes; the 2011 minutes allegation was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board failed to comply with OML 2014-10 by not amending its April 8, 2013 minutes at its March 10 meeting to add a document list and adequate, correct information.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the amended minutes comply with the Open Meeting Law and our order in OML 2014­10.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the February 26 minutes were not sufficiently detailed because they omitted a summary of the Board's discussion of prior OML complaints against the Board.
allegations.key_passage: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to include an accurate and sufficient summary in its February 26 meeting minutes of its discussion about amending its April 8, 2013 minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the February 26 minutes omitted a list of certain emails the Board reviewed, which a member wanted added to the April 8, 2013 minutes.
allegations.key_passage: The Board's decision not to include information about emails that were not actually discussed during the April 8, 2013 meeting did not violate the law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged minutes of the Board's August 22, 2012 meeting are missing or incomplete.
allegations.key_passage: This determination does not address any other complaints that may be pending with the Board or with our office.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board has not created minutes for meetings held in 2011, a generalized audit-type allegation.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review these allegations because our office will  not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Amend the minutes of the February 26 meeting to include the level of detail required by the Law.
Board members review the Attorney General's training video on minutes.
Board must certify compliance to the AG's office within thirty days using the attached form.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
